archetype: Custom: Minecraft Retro-Voxel (Vibrant Play + Retro Terminal)

rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing.
Apply a crisp text-shadow to headings to simulate the Minecraft title effect: `text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #383838`.
Ensure body text in VT323 is large enough (min text-xl) because pixel fonts can be hard to read at small sizes.
NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serif for this project.
Use #C6C6C6 (Stone Gray) as the base for all panels, cards, and buttons to mimic Minecraft UI screens.
Use Diamond, Emerald, and Gold for achievement highlights and badges.
Ensure high contrast: White text on dark/colored buttons needs a dark gray/black text-shadow (`2px 2px 0px #383838`) to be readable.
Text inside the Minecraft-style buttons should typically be white with a dark shadow, just like in the game.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Use a Tetris-style Grid for the main fraction workspace (chunky, uneven boxes), and a Control Room Grid for the dashboard/inventory.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous but chunky spacing: p-4, p-8. Avoid small fractional spacing to maintain the blocky feel.

borders_and_shadows.panels: bg-[#C6C6C6] border-[4px] border-t-[#FFFFFF] border-l-[#FFFFFF] border-b-[#555555] border-r-[#555555]
borders_and_shadows.buttons: bg-[#C6C6C6] border-[4px] border-black shadow-[inset_4px_4px_0px_#FFFFFF,inset_-4px_-4px_0px_#555555] hover:bg-[#7EA1ED] text-white text-shadow-sm

FractionVisualizer.description: Visual representation of fractions using CSS grids mimicking Minecraft blocks.
FractionVisualizer.styles: Use a CSS grid (e.g., grid-cols-2, grid-cols-3) with gap-1 or gap-2. Active block units use the 'blocks' border/shadow style. Inactive blocks use bg-black/20 with border-2 border-dashed border-black/30.

MinecraftButton.description: Primary action button across the app.
MinecraftButton.styles: Blocky, NO border-radius (`rounded-none`). Uses the 'buttons' shadow pattern. On hover: bg-[#7EA1ED] (Minecraft selection blue). Text must be white with a dark text-shadow.

XPProgressBar.description: Progress bar resembling the Minecraft XP/level bar.
XPProgressBar.styles: Container: h-6 bg-black border-2 border-[#555555] p-[2px]. Fill: bg-[#41F076] border-t-2 border-[#AAFFAA] border-b-2 border-[#00AA00].

AchievementBadge.styles: Square container, border-4 border-black, background color matching the ore (e.g., Diamond #47E5C3). Add an inner blocky glow using inset shadows. Center a Lucide icon heavily styled to look retro.

InventorySlot.description: Used for holding fraction numbers or dragging answers.
InventorySlot.styles: w-16 h-16 bg-[#8B8B8B] shadow-[inset_4px_4px_0px_#383838,inset_-4px_-4px_0px_#FFFFFF] flex items-center justify-center text-2xl text-white.

Modal.description: Used for level complete, word problems, or dialogs.
Modal.styles: Centered, max-w-2xl, bg-[#C6C6C6], border-[4px] border-black with inner inset bevel (white top/left, dark gray bottom/right). Title in gold text with black shadow.

rules: Keep animations retro and blocky. Avoid smooth, easing curves.
Use stepped animations (`steps(4)`) if doing any CSS transitions.
Hover effects should be instantaneous color/shadow swaps, not smooth transitions.
Add a slight CSS 'shake' animation for wrong answers.
Level up should have a 'pop' scale effect without smoothing.
Do not use generic smooth illustrations.
Apply pixelated aesthetics to UI elements via CSS.
Build blocky patterns using CSS linear-gradients, grids, and box-shadows.
For a background, use CSS linear gradient for sky blue, and a bottom fixed block for grass.

attributes: All views/screens, inputs, and modals must have a parent `data-testid`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Press Start 2P' (for headings) and 'VT323' (for body/numbers) in the main index.html or global CSS.
Do NOT use `border-radius` anywhere. Every corner must be sharp (`rounded-none`).

Build the FractionVisualizer using pure CSS grids and background colors. Do not rely on external images for the blocks. Use heavy border-bottom (dirt color) and background (grass color) to make it look like a voxel block.
Implement local browser storage (`localStorage`) for saving XP, level progression, and achievement badges.
Integrate the LLM for generating math word problems. Ensure the prompt explicitly asks for 'Minecraft themed fraction word problems for 10-year-olds'.

Replace generic Shadcn component styles with the Retro/Minecraft specific inset box-shadows and borders defined in the colors and layout sections. If Shadcn components are too hard to strip of modern styles, use raw HTML/Tailwind for the heavy UI pieces.
Text shadows are critical. Extend Tailwind config to include a custom utility for text-shadow (e.g., `.text-shadow-sm { text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px #383838 }`).
Ensure all math symbols (+, -, *, /) use the VT323 font and are large and highly legible.
